output.headline: Kowalski's hat-trick sinks Ironvale as Harbour City roar back
output.text: Ironvale Athletic came flying out of the blocks, and Zeke Mbeki nearly scored right away, but his close-range shot was blocked. He made up for it before the half-hour, firing in after a lovely ball from Luca Romero to put Ironvale ahead. Then Mbeki wasted another golden chance from close range, and that miss would haunt them. Right after the break, Leo Marchetti struck a surprise equaliser for Harbour City, and suddenly the home side were buzzing. From there, it was the Dani Kowalski show: he scored three goals, finishing with a late tap-in, as Harbour City's constant pressing wore Ironvale down. Ironvale created the better chances, but Harbour City took theirs, and that is why they won so comfortably.
